summary: Norwood Financial Corp (Nasdaq: NWFL), the $2.9 billion-asset holding company for Wayne Bank, filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026 disclosing that its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.32 per share. The dividend is payable November 2, 2026 to shareholders of record as of October 15, 2026, unchanged from the prior quarter. No premium, deal value or advisor is involved. The event is a routine capital-return action with no valuation overhang or regulatory clock; the risk-arb angle is simply the modest forward yield and payout sustainability.
